Z(G): the center {x in G : xg=gx for every g in G} of G
C_G(x): the centralizer {g in G : gx=xg} of x in G
[G:H]: the index in G of a subgroup H
r: the nonnegative number of noncentral conjugacy classes
x_i: a representative of the i-th noncentral conjugacy class
[G:C_G(x)]: the index of C_G(x) in G, namely the number of its left cosets
p: the prime occurring in the theorem
G: the finite group occurring in the theorem
n: the integer at least 1 such that |G|=p^n
Cl_G(x): the conjugacy class of x in G
i: an index satisfying 1 at most i at most r
a: an element of C_G(x) used to verify the subgroup property
b: an element of C_G(x) used to verify the subgroup property
g: an arbitrary element of G used in conjugation and cosets
h: an arbitrary element of G used to compare cosets
c: an element of C_G(x) relating two equal left cosets
G/C_G(x): the set of left cosets of C_G(x) in G
mathcal C(x): the conjugacy class {gxg^{-1}: g in G} of x
phi: the map from G/C_G(x) to mathcal C(x) sending gC_G(x) to gxg^{-1}
mathscr N: the finite set of nonsingleton conjugacy classes of G
mathcal K: a conjugacy class in mathscr N
